text: 1st Semester: Baaki dino ki tarah he normal day, going to the class, sitting on the bench and listening to the teacher🫩. But at a moment, the NORMAL day converted to SPECIAL one 😍, because -- I saw a girl 🥰 sitting on the middle row, rightmost side, silently sitting unlike her group. The seriousness, the beauty drove my heart away.🤌

“We are most alive when we’re in love.” ~ John Updike...
If I were to read this phrase before 6 February, 2026 6:00 PM, I would never be able to comprehend this sentence 🙄. Yes, It was the first time, when we got introduced to each other in real life🥰. One of the most beautiful day, that I have witnessed in my life😘😘. The day, when I realised maybe taking IIIT Kota isn't too bad decision of my Life 😅😅. While walking by, we talked a lot, sach batau toh, Literally, itni baat first meeting me naa toh tumhe he ki hogi and naa he mene ki thi.😍😍

Next day, we went to Riverfront, honestly that first outing in Kota became so special for me, because I was with my Love 👉👈. Initially, I was a bit hesitating to have a conversation with you. But when we we about to get tickets, I ran upto you and initiated the conversation😅😅.
That day, I spent my most of the time with you. From moving through the Riverfront or that Gulli of Allen Kota. Everytime, I was with you.
The return from that Chai ki Dukaan to near city mall was a bit special 🫣🙄, because you know, that was the first time when we accidently touched each other's hand 😉😉
The spark from the touch of that moment still gives me goosebumps.🫣🫣

After the next day, we were studying together in Computer Center 👉👈. 
After that day, our friendship deepened more and more. Even ki, afterwards, bohot se ese time bhi aaye, jab humari baatein nahi hoti thi 😓. Uss time par naa jaane kyun, but bohot ajeeb saa feel hota tha. Esa lagta tha ki maano, mere jeewan ka ek bohot he important part missing hai🥺. Bss din bhar yehi baatein socha karta tha. Uss time par itna door hote hue bhi naa jaane kyun itna connected feel karta tha🥹🥹. 
Tumse baat nahi karne par mujhpr kya beet ti thi, everyone, who were close to me, witnessed this. A message ignored from you made me go crazy for many days straight. But at the end, sab theek hoo jaata tha😋😋.

Baatein aage badhi, toh tumhe khone ke darr se meri aatma tak kaanp jaati thi 🥺🥺, esa lagta tha ki kahin tumhe koi mujhse door na karde😔. Darte darte 4 March 2026 ki raat ko confess kiya. Sach bataun toh drr toh bohot he zyada lag raha tha ki yeh jo sab hai, kahin sirf meri taraf se he toh nahi hai. Phir aaya tumhara reply, jisko mai sahi se interpret nahi kar paaya🥺. Honestly bataun, toh that was the best reply that you could've gave, kyunki it's not easy for a girl to trust on someone so quickly🥹. It all was my fault to think it like that. Khair, uss baat ko hataooo.🙄

Haan, toh fir uske baad humari baatein wapas se shuru hui, iss baar jyada stronger😘😘. Iss time tak toh you knew my feelings and tumhe bhi mere liye feelings aa gayi thi. Baatein hoti thi humari toh usme pata chalta toh tha tumhaare hints ka, but darr sa rehta thoda saa ki wapas se wohi galti naa repeat kardu😓😓, isliye mene bhi try nahi kiya tha zyada hardly, but when you used to say "Sir" 🫠🫠🫠🫠 haayeeeeee. Unn times par toh lag jaata thaa ki meri ma'am ke mann me feeling toh hain 🫣🫣🫣🫣👉👈.

and then comes that special day of 15 March 2026, around 10:00PM 👉👈🫣. Jab tak dono he sure the ki hume aaj nahi toh kal, ek dusre ka saath dena he dena hai. Uss time par tumne thoda sa bola tha ki aaj he boldo, but I hesitated 🙄🙄. kyunki MTE chal rahe the, but phir date par dhyaan diya toh socha ki this 15 already plays such special role in my life, why not associate another special occasion with this. So, I CONFESSED😋😋👉👈. Uss raat, yeh jaante hue bhi ki next day CST ka paper hai, we spend whole night with each other. "😘😘" iss waale emoji par kitna discussion hua tha 😅😅😅😅😅. Phir aaya saamne milne wala din -- first time after Holi. 18 March 2026, jab we met for the first time after that Holi wala incident took place🙄🙄👉👈. Uss time par walk karte karte he baatein kar rahe the, phir mene jidd kiya toh phir tum bhi bench par bethi, but ek person ka space chhodkar🙄🙄. Uss din aur aaj ke din me kitnaaaaaa jyaadaaa difference hai. Virtually emoji send karke kiss karne se lekar Real Life me kiss karne tak, Ek seat chhodkar bethne se lekar EK HE SEAT PAR BETHNE tak ka safar 😋😋😋😋😋. And humara relationship start hote he, we have to face 10 days separation 😣. Uske baad we decided to meet only 4 days a week, but pyaar kisi specific din ka mohtaaz thode he hota hai. We ended up meeting each and every single day😋😋😋.

and then one day, I gathered my courage, asked for you mobile and put it inside my pocket and grabbed my bubuuuuu's hands 👉👈🫣🫣. The 2nd of April witnessed that moment. We walk a while, you were hesitating because you thought ki I would feel uncomfortable holding your hands🙄🙄, because your hands sweat a lot, but Bubuuuu, at that moment you forgot ki I love everything, which is from my Bubuuuu😘😘😘. Those sweats weren't gross, those were Holy Water for me🫣🫣👉👈😍😍. 
The following day, 3rd of April, we hugged each other🫣🫣. I was hesitating a little bit, you asked me, "Hug karna hai!?", I was thinking, ki how you would've know 👉👈🫣🫣. So, we finally hugged on 3rd April 2026. I really felt like, I'm in space. Every noise inside my head was gone, it was just "YOU" and "ME".
and now comes 6th April 2026, while hugging, I secretly kissed on your neck🫣🫣. Later I asked you, whether you felt it or not. You said "No"🙄🙄. So, nevermind, it's still a memorable day for me, when my lips touched your necks.🫶🫶

Now, we on 12th of April 2026, when everyone in the college was busy in enjoying DJ Night🥳🥳, We were secretly enjoying too, the day marks the when our Lips touched each other and never got separated😘😘😍😍. The day when, we finally Kissed each other, not just for 10 minutes, but for approximately 90 minutes🫣🫣, under the Skyshots😍😍🥰. How beautiful day it wasssss. Away from crowd, where it was just "us", no any other single soul, who keep passing by to disturb us or occupied the bench🙄🙄👉👈. Each and every second of that moment will always be cherished😘😘. The time when, I wanted to stop everything and live the moment at it's fullest.💋💋

So, the passes by, there were time, jab humare beech me kaafi ladaiyan bhi hui hai, kabhi kabhi toh mazak-mazak ka gussa hona shaam tak sachhi wala gussa hona ho jaata tha🙄🙄👉👈 (yaad hai naa woh Saturday waali ladai 🙄🙄??). But just like we handled other situations, we also handled theseeee chhoti chhoti sii misunderstandings😘😘😘. We did, We do and We always will🤝💋💋😘😘😘😘. These misunderstanding won't shake the foundations of we built on pure love and affection❤️❤️❤️🫂🫂🫂. The Love we shared is precious for both of us.🫂🫂

The days passing, our trust, intimacy, love and understanding grew (and still growing) exponentially🥹🥹🫰🫰. On 11th of May, on the 2nd Floor, We went to Tutorial Room, we started by studying, but then after few minutes later, we started Kissing💋💋. Just like everyother kiss we did in Privately, my hands went to Mr. Milky Twin👉👈🙄🙄, I grabbed you by your waist (with skin-to-skin touch)🫠🫠🫠, my hands raised to your Bra, and then I started adoring Mr. Milky Twins by outside, then by mutual consent, you lifted your bra🫣🫣. and I WITNESSED THE MOST BEAUTIFUL CREATION -- the literal meaning of perfection🤌🤌, the most amazing Boobies in this whole World🫣🫣. I played with Mr. Milky Twins, pehle bhi khela hai, but this date marks the first time skin-to-skin contact between me and Mr. Milky Twins. and on 13th of May, I 🫣🫣🫣🫣 (you knowwww kyaaaa🫣🫣)...

Now, on 16th, my train was scheduled, I had to leave by 4 PM, but I wanted to spend each and every second with my Bubuuuuu 🥹🥹🥹🥹. That day we, quietly were with each other, the whole day, like from 9:30 to I guess 2 PM. I still remember, I was so overwhelmed with a lot of emotions that, I could not grab enough courage to turn back and look at you🥺, call you🥺, kiss you🥺 for the one more time before leaving for the Hostel🥺🥺. Even though, we are separated physically, but at the core of my heart, I'm alwayssss, alwaysssss with you, my Bubuuuu😘😘😘😘😘. This mere 765 KM is just physical distance, from our hearts, we both are interwined and can't be separated.😘😘😘💋💋💋💋🫶🫶🫶🫰🫰🫰🫰..

So, Yeah that was my way of Wishing you birthday, now go to Next Page and check my another message.
